title: Vacilando Runtime — snapshot & event contracts (v1)
description: Stable, delivery-adapter-independent contract for the Command Center snapshot produced by lib/vacilando/compose.mjs and served by lib/vacilando-server.mjs. The snapshot is a PROJECTION of authoritative toolkit state (alloy-ro + git + ~/.local/state/alloy-dev); it is never a parallel store. Every field maps to a source (see docs/platform/planning/vacilando-os/RUNTIME-PHASE-1.md §3). Missing sources become entries in `gaps`, never fabricated values. Time is injected at compose so a snapshot is a deterministic function of state + one clock reading.

fields.generated_at: ISO-8601 UTC, injected by the emitter (projections never read the wall clock).
fields.sources: Per-source health {worker_status, agent_status, dev_status, runtime_paths} → {ok, error}.
fields.project: Project Runtime: {key, name, root, base_ref, base_sha, sprint_keys[], epics[], projects_available[], gaps[]}.
fields.headline: Metric strip: {active_sprints, workers_running:{running,total}, questions_pending, prs_ready, tests_passing:{value,gap}, staging_sync, needs_you}.
fields.sprints: Sprint Runtime[]: {slot, key, title, objective, glyph, provider, status, lifecycle, initiative_key, stage, phase:{label,index,total}, progress:{value,derived,source,note}, git:{state,ahead,behind}, server, port, branch, questions[], question_count, evidence_count, updated_at_ms}.
fields.workers: Worker Runtime[]: {id, provider, slot, glyph, role, lifecycle, agent_status, health, current_sprint, ownership:{worktree_path,session_id,opened_at,created_at}, server, port, last_activity_ms, last_commit}.
fields.approvals: Approval Runtime: {total, questions[], reviews[], merges[], promotions[], counts}. Project-wide over ALL initiatives, not just slots.
fields.activity: Activity Runtime[]: {at_ms, at, kind, actor, sprint, summary, detail, source}. Projected from git log + metadata timestamps + evidence mtimes; time-ordered desc.
fields.gaps: []{field, reason, would_need} — everything a widget wants that no authoritative source yields yet. Surfaced, never invented.

events.transport: Server-Sent Events at GET /api/events; adapter-independent (WebSocket/push/mobile may be added without changing shapes).

frames.snapshot: The full snapshot object above; sent on connect and on each server tick. A read-only stream in Phase 1 — no command frames exist yet.

future_event_types: These land when a durable runtime event log exists (Phase 2); the snapshot contract above is stable regardless.

invariants: Read-only: this contract is produced by projection; no field is a command result.
No parallel model: every field resolves to alloy-ro, git, or an authoritative state file.
Deterministic: same state + same injected time → byte-identical snapshot (stable ids/order).
Fail soft: a missing source yields sources[].ok=false plus a gaps[] entry; the server serves last-good.
No secrets: projections never carry credential/env values (enforced by test).
